name: tafazzin, phospholipid-lysophospholipid transacylase

function.text: TAFAZZIN encodes tafazzin. Annotated molecular activities include 1-acylglycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase activity and 1-acylglycerophosphocholine O-acyltransferase activity. It participates in cristae formation and cardiolipin acyl-chain remodeling.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Barth syndrome (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
